test.create_query: CREATE TABLE single_level_fanout_t1 (oid UInt64, cid Int32, cr DateTime, h String, s1 Int32) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY oid
CREATE TABLE single_level_fanout_t2 (oid UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY oid
CREATE TABLE single_level_fanout_t3 (cid Int32, h String, ref DateTime, s2 Float64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (cid, h, ref)
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO single_level_fanout_t1 SELECT intDiv(number, 5), toInt32(intDiv(number, 5) % 4), toDateTime('2026-09-08 00:00:00') + toIntervalMinute(intDiv(number, 5) % 1440) + toIntervalSecond(number % 5), toString(intDiv(number, 5) % 200), toInt32(number % 300) FROM numbers(300000)
INSERT INTO single_level_fanout_t2 SELECT number FROM numbers(60000)

INSERT INTO single_level_fanout_t3 SELECT toInt32(number % 4), toString(intDiv(number, 4) % 200), toDateTime('2026-09-08 00:00:00') + toIntervalMinute(intDiv(number, 800)), toFloat64(number % 5) / 2 FROM numbers(1152000)
test.query: SELECT cid, count() AS n, round(avg(m), 3) AS a FROM ( SELECT e.cid AS cid, e.h AS h, e.s AS s, argMin(p.s2, abs(p.s2 - e.s)) AS m FROM ( SELECT e.oid AS oid, e.cid AS cid, argMax(toStartOfMinute(e.cr), e.cr) AS t0, argMax(e.h, e.cr) AS h, argMax(least(4., greatest(1., 1. + (e.s1 / 100.))), e.cr) AS s FROM single_level_fanout_t1 AS e INNER JOIN single_level_fanout_t2 AS k ON e.oid = k.oid WHERE e.cid IN (0, 1, 2, 3) GROUP BY e.oid, e.cid ) AS e LEFT JOIN single_level_fanout_t3 AS p ON p.h = e.h AND p.cid = e.cid AND p.ref >= e.t0 - toIntervalMinute(3) AND p.ref <= e.t0 + toIntervalMinute(1) GROUP BY e.oid, e.cid, e.h, e.s ) GROUP BY cid FORMAT Null SETTINGS join_algorithm = '{join_algorithm}'

SELECT cid, count() AS n, round(avg(m), 3) AS a FROM ( SELECT e.cid AS cid, e.h AS h, e.s AS s, argMin(p.s2, abs(p.s2 - e.s)) AS m FROM ( SELECT toUInt16(e.oid) AS oid, any(e.cid) AS cid, argMax(toStartOfMinute(e.cr), e.cr) AS t0, argMax(e.h, e.cr) AS h, argMax(least(4., greatest(1., 1. + (e.s1 / 100.))), e.cr) AS s FROM single_level_fanout_t1 AS e INNER JOIN single_level_fanout_t2 AS k ON e.oid = k.oid GROUP BY oid ) AS e LEFT JOIN single_level_fanout_t3 AS p ON p.h = e.h AND p.cid = e.cid AND p.ref >= e.t0 - toIntervalMinute(3) AND p.ref <= e.t0 + toIntervalMinute(1) GROUP BY e.oid, e.cid, e.h, e.s ) GROUP BY cid FORMAT Null SETTINGS enable_parallel_single_level_merge = 1, enable_adaptive_aggregator = 1
